title: ExpectedGroundTruth
description: Per-level ground truth written to variants/<levelId>/expected.json and read by a generic verifier via HARBOR_VARIANT_DIR. Fields are mode-dependent; additionalProperties is allowed so task authors can add task_* extras.

mode.description: Overrides experiment.json.submissionSchema for this level if set.

output_artifact.description: Filename under /app/output the agent must produce (e.g. plan_comparison.json).

source_url.description: Optional constraint: the submission's recorded source URL must equal this.

option_ids.description: compare_choose/search_select: canonical option id -> canonical label. Defines the valid choice set and expected label mapping.

require_all_options_considered.description: compare_choose: task_options_considered must contain exactly the full option_ids set.

constraints.description: Free-form key/value constraints the submission must match verbatim (e.g. task_billing_mode: monthly, ticker: MU).
